30744-the-works-of-robert-louis-stevenso.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _In the volume now in your hands, the authors have touched upon that ugly devil of crime, with which it is your glory to have contended. It were a waste of ink to do so in a serious spirit. Let us dedicate our horror to acts of a more mingled strain, where crime preserves some features of nobility, and where reason and humanity can still relish the temptation.

arxiv-2102-13609.title: Leading-Color Two-Loop QCD Corrections for Three-Jet Production at Hadron Colliders Preprint: CERN-TH-2021-023 FR-PHENO-2021-06 MPP-2021-20
arxiv-2102-13609.creator: S. Abreu, F. Febres Cordero, H. Ita, B. Page, and V. Sotnikov
arxiv-2102-13609.description: Abstract We present the complete set of leading-color two-loop contributions required to obtain next-to-next-to-leading-order (NNLO) QCD corrections to three-jet production at hadron colliders. We obtain analytic expressions for a generating set of finite remainders, valid in the physical region for three-jet production.

arxiv-2104-00830.title: A Faber-Krahn inequality for mixed local and nonlocal operators Thanks: The authors are members of INdAM. S. Biagi is partially supported by the INdAM-GNAMPA project Metodi topologici per problemi al contorno associati a certe classi di equazioni alle derivate parziali . S. Dipierro and E. Valdinoci
arxiv-2104-00830.creator: Stefano Biagi, Serena Dipierro, Enrico Valdinoci, Eugenio Vecchi
arxiv-2104-00830.description: Abstract . We consider the first Dirichlet eigenvalue problem for a mixed local/nonlocal elliptic operator and we establish a quantitative Faber-Krahn inequality. More precisely, we show that balls minimize the first eigenvalue among sets of given volume and we provide a stability result for sets that almost attain the minimum. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 49Q10, 35R11, 47A75, 49R05 1.

arxiv-2105-10333.title: Ecology in the digital world of Wikipedia
arxiv-2105-10333.creator: Fumiko Ogushi, János Kertész, Kimmo Kaski, Takashi Shimada
arxiv-2105-10333.description: Abstract Wikipedia, a paradigmatic example of online knowledge space is organized in a collaborative, bottom-up way with voluntary contributions, yet it maintains a level of reliability comparable to that of traditional encyclopedias. The lack of selected professional writers and editors makes the judgement about quality and trustworthiness of the articles a real challenge.

arxiv-2107-00716.title: The Highly Self-Absorbed Blazar, PKS 1351 − - 018 Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2107-00716.creator: Brian Punsly, Sándor Frey, Cormac Reynolds, Paola Marziani, Alexander Pushkarev, Sina Chen, Shang Li, Preeti Kharb
arxiv-2107-00716.description: Abstract PKS 1351 − - 018 at a redshift of z = 3.71 z=3.71 is one of the most luminous, steady synchrotron sources with a luminosity > 10 47 >10^{47} erg s -1 . The synchrotron luminosity does not seem to vary by more than ∼ 25 % \sim 25\% over 35 years.

arxiv-2402-03609.title: A regularity theory for evolution equations with time-measurable pseudo-differential operators in weighted mixed-norm Sobolev-Lipschitz spaces
arxiv-2402-03609.creator: Jae-Hwan Choi
arxiv-2402-03609.description: Abstract . This paper investigates the existence, uniqueness, and regularity of solutions to evolution equations with time-measurable pseudo-differential operators in weighted mixed-norm Sobolev-Lipschitz spaces. We also explore trace embedding and continuity of solutions. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 35K99, 35S10 Secondary: 47G30, 26A16, 35D35 1. Introduction and Main results 1.1. Goal and Setting Consider the following Cauchy problem: \begin{cases}\partial_{t}u(t,x)=\psi(t,-i\nabla)u(t,x)+f(t,x),\quad&(t,x)\in(0,T)\times\mathbb{R}^{d},\\ u(0,x)=u_{0}(x)\quad&x\in\mathbb{R}^{d}.

arxiv-2407-00094.title: Berwald m m -Kropina Spaces of Arbitrary Signature: Metrizability and Ricci-Flatness
arxiv-2407-00094.creator: Sjors Heefer
arxiv-2407-00094.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sjors Heefer. The (pseudo-)Riemann-metrizability and Ricci-flatness of Finsler spaces with m m -Kropina metric F = α 1 + m ​ β − m F=\alpha^{1+m}\beta^{-m} of Berwald type are investigated. We prove that the affine connection of F F can locally be understood as the Levi-Civita connection of some (pseudo-)Riemannian metric if and only if the Ricci tensor of the canonical affine connection is symmetric. We also obtain a third equivalent characterization in terms of the covariant derivative of the 1-form β \beta .

Here we present Keck and Gemini observations of the host that reveal a redshift z = 0.

arxiv-2507-12953.title: cIDIR \operatorname{cIDIR} : Conditioned Implicit Neural Representation for Regularized Deformable Image Registration
arxiv-2507-12953.creator: Sidaty El hadramy, Oumeymah Cherkaoui, Philippe C. Cattin
arxiv-2507-12953.description: Abstract Regularization is essential in deformable image registration (DIR) to ensure that the estimated Deformation Vector Field (DVF) remains smooth, physically plausible, and anatomically consistent. However, fine-tuning regularization parameters in learning-based DIR frameworks is computationally expensive, often requiring multiple training iterations.

arxiv-2509-09982.title: Evaluation of Black-Box XAI Approaches for Predictors of Values of Boolean Formulae
arxiv-2509-09982.creator: Stav Armoni-Friedmann, Hana Chockler, David A. Kelly
arxiv-2509-09982.description: Abstract Evaluating explainable AI (XAI) approaches is a challenging task in general, due to the subjectivity of explanations. In this paper, we focus on tabular data and the specific use case of AI models predicting the values of Boolean functions.

arxiv-2602-04109.title: Tinker Tales: Supporting Child–AI Collaboration through Co-Creative Storytelling with Educational Scaffolding DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Interaction Design and Children; June 22–25, 2026; Brighton, United Kingdom ISBN: XXX-X-XXXX-XXXX-X/XXXX/XX CCS: Human-centered computing Interactive systems
arxiv-2602-04109.creator: Nayoung Choi, Jiseung Hong, Peace Cyebukayire, Ikseon Choi, Jinho D. Choi
arxiv-2602-04109.description: Abstract . Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly framed as a collaborative partner in creative activities, yet children’s interactions with AI have largely been studied in AI-led instructional settings rather than co-creative collaboration. This leaves open questions about how children can meaningfully engage with AI through iterative co-creation.

arxiv-2602-24266.title: Efficient Discovery of Approximate Causal Abstractions via Neural Mechanism Sparsification
arxiv-2602-24266.creator: Amir Asiaee
arxiv-2602-24266.description: Abstract Neural networks are hypothesized to implement interpretable causal mechanisms, yet verifying this requires finding a causal abstraction —a simpler, high-level Structural Causal Model (SCM) faithful to the network under interventions. Discovering such abstractions is hard: it typically demands brute-force interchange interventions or retraining. We reframe the problem by viewing structured pruning as a search over approximate abstractions.

pmc-10834670.creator: Ashlin Rakhra, Cole Hooley, Meredith P. Fort, Mary Beth Weber, LeShawndra Price, Hoa L. Nguyen, Manuel Ramirez, Adamson S. Muula, Mina Hosseinipour, Kingsley Apusiga, Victor Davila-Roman, Joyce Gyamfi, Kezia Gladys Amaning Adjei, Josephine Andesia, Annette Fitzpatrick, Pascal Launois, Ana A. Baumann
pmc-10834670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionNon-communicable diseases (NCDs) are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in low-and middle- income countries (LMICs). Despite this, a lack of funding, training and mentorship for NCD investigators in LMICs exists.

pmc-11507014.title: Reporter Alleles in hiPSCs: Visual Cues on Development and Disease
pmc-11507014.creator: Gustavo Caldeira Cotta, Rachel Castro Teixeira dos Santos, Guilherme Mattos Jardim Costa, Samyra Maria dos Santos Nassif Lacerda
pmc-11507014.description: Reporter alleles are essential for advancing research with human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs), notably in developmental biology and disease modeling. This study investigates the state-of-the-art gene-editing techniques tailored for generating reporter alleles in hiPSCs, emphasizing their effectiveness in investigating cellular dynamics and disease mechanisms.

pmc-11537769.title: Lysine Acetyltransferase TIP60 Restricts Nerve Injury by Activating IKKβ/SNAP23 Axis‐Mediated Autophagosome‐Lysosome Fusion in Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-11537769.creator: Wei Wang, Jun Min, Qinghua Luo, Xunhu Gu, Min Li, Xu Liu
pmc-11537769.description: ObjectiveThe hyperphosphorylation of Tau protein is considered an important cause of neuronal degeneration in Alzheimer's disease (AD). The disruption of neuronal histone acetylation homeostasis mediated by Tip60 HAT is a common early event in neurodegenerative diseases, but the deeper regulatory mechanism on β‐amyloid peptide (Aβ)‐induced neurotoxicity and autophagic function in AD is still unclear.

pmc-12609249.title: Automated Nonlinear Acoustics System for Real-Time Monitoring of Cement-Based Composites
pmc-12609249.creator: Theodoti Z Kordatou, Dimitrios A Exarchos, Theodore E Matikas, Tat-Hean Gan
pmc-12609249.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Developed a fully automated nonlinear acoustics monitoring system combining bulk-wave excitation with non-contact Laser Doppler Vibrometry (LDV) detection.Validated the system’s stability, linearity, and repeatability, and demonstrated its capability for real-time monitoring of cement-based composites during hydration. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12779995.title: Increased integration and synergy in EEG- and fNIRS-based data in migraine patients after a three-month treatment with galcanezumab: relations with long-term clinical outcome
pmc-12779995.creator: Marianna La Rocca, Antonio Lacalamita, Livio Clemente, Giulia Paparella, Elena Ammendola, Nicola Amoroso, Emmanuella Ladisa, Alfonso Monaco, Sebastiano Stramaglia, Roberto Bellotti, Marina de Tommaso
pmc-12779995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Galcanezumab is a well-tolerated monoclonal antibody developed for migraine prophylaxis. Although its action mechanisms are not fully understood, they may involve changes in cortical connectivity. This study explores galcanezumab-induced central changes by investigating metabolic-electrical brain interactions and network properties. We analyzed electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) during visual stimulation through connectivity and high-order interaction analyses using Partial information decomposition (PID). Furthermore, we explored the relationship between neurophysiological measures and long-term clinical effects.

pmc-13019070.title: Identification of STEAP4, EPC1, and CLEC1B as non-invasive candidate biomarkers for hepatocellular carcinoma using integrated bioinformatics analysis
pmc-13019070.creator: Soheyla Khojand, Neda Zahmatkesh, Arezoo Hassani, Zahra Damerchiloo, Zahra Nikoo, Roozbeh Heidarzadehpilehrood
pmc-13019070.description: Highlight•Cytokine-related pathways dysregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)•STEAP4, EPC1, CLEC1B, and LCN2 were identified as the shared non-invasive biomarkers.• Targeted miRNAs were identified, including miR-107, miR-326, GAS5, MALAT1, PRLP0P6, and SNHG1. •Protein-protein networks were constructed between mRNAs and miRNAs in HCC.

pmc-13195842.title: Amyloid-β PET scans, economic strain and financial decision-making among persons with cognitive impairment and care partners: a mixed-methods analysis of the CARE-IDEAS study
pmc-13195842.creator: Courtney H. Van Houtven, Cassie B. Ford, Elyse Couch, Megan Shepherd-Banigan, Wenhan Zhang, Emmanuelle Bélanger, Brenda L. Plassman, James R. Burke, Corinna Sorenson, Nicole DePasquale, Emily O’Brien, Eric Jutkowitz, Terrie Wetle, Valerie A. Smith
pmc-13195842.description: BackgroundTo explore the relationship between receipt of amyloid-β PET scan results and subsequent experiences of economic strain and financial decision-making for persons with cognitive impairment and their care partners.MethodsA parallel convergent mixed-methods design where quantitative and qualitative data were simultaneously collected and analyzed.

pmc-13338838.title: Food Safety and Nutritional Aspects of Plant‐Based Dairy and Meat Alternatives: A Review
pmc-13338838.creator: Elina Sohlberg, Petra Pasonen, Hanna‐Leena Alakomi, Johanna Suomi
pmc-13338838.description: The consumption and availability of plant‐based dairy and milk alternatives are increasing. These products can contain chemical and microbiological hazards, which are not prevalent in animal‐based foods. On the other hand, the occurrence of foodborne hazards such as contaminants or pathogens found in animal‐based foods can also be lower in plant‐based alternatives.

pmc-13373215.title: Two-photon interference between independent atomic and quantum dot single-photon sources for hybrid quantum network
pmc-13373215.creator: Kyu-Young Kim, Heewoo Kim, Dong Hyun Park, Jinhyuk Bae, Gyeongmin Ju, Suk In Park, Jin Dong Song, Je-Hyung Kim, Han Seb Moon
pmc-13373215.description: Hybrid quantum systems play a crucial role in advancing scalable and versatile quantum networks as they combine the strengths of different quantum platforms. An important challenge for the development of hybrid quantum networks lies in interfacing heterogeneous quantum nodes and distributing entanglement among them. Single photons emitted from these dissimilar quantum nodes typically show distinct spectral and temporal properties.
